leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure a React application to use React Router for client-side navigation.
Implement a basic routing structure using BrowserRouter and Route components.
Construct a navigation menu with Link components to switch between views without page reloads.
Apply dynamic routing by extracting URL parameters to render specific content.
Initialize and render nested routes to organize complex page layouts.
Manipulate navigation programmatically using the useNavigate hook.
Integrate a 404 error page to handle unmatched routes gracefully.
